answer.evidence: The assertion logic is in radon/visitors.py: ComplexityVisitor.__init__ stores no_assert (line 165), and visit_Assert (line 256-260) does `self.complexity += not self.no_assert`, so an assert adds 1 only when no_assert is False. The flag is propagated to nested visitors at lines 279 and 313. Review should check that radon/complexity.py passes no_assert through its entry points (e.g. cc_visit and cc_visit_ast) into ComplexityVisitor, and that radon/metrics.py callers that compute complexity use consistent defaults. The unit tests in radon/tests/test_complexity_utils.py (line 115 checks the default no_assert is False) should be extended with a case that compares scores with the flag on and off. The bool-to-int addition in visit_Assert is terse and could be written as an explicit conditional. radon/raw.py does not involve this logic, so it only needs a quick check.
